# Tuya TV Viewer v0.11.0 beta 4: WebRTC

Beta 4 adds H.264 live view through WebRTC and the Tuya EU portal protocol. It signs in automatically with username/password and performs an internal web-session exchange without QR scanning or the official Tuya SDK. Includes a 2×2 grid, full-screen playback, resume after pausing, and stream reconnection. Verified on Android 16 with four cameras; older Fire TV and Android TV devices had not yet been tested. Uses the secondary SD stream to reduce load. Android 7+, ARMv7/ARM64. Debug-signed manual test build.
